subject: Request to change Jul 26 demo → two-part technical sprint + PoC plan
messages:
From: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@acme-corp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-devs@acme-corp.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: switch upcoming demo (Jul 26) to technical sprint + PoC plan

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from our side — the stakeholders on our end reviewed the agenda and asked if we can convert the Jul 26 intro demo into a two-part technical engagement: 1) an architecture deep-dive (60–90m) focused on integration and latency expectations, and 2) a hands-on scoping lab (3 hours) to outline a target PoC and success metrics. Execs and the engineering leads would prefer this format so the evaluation is actionable for procurement.

We know this is more time than the original slot; our goals are to leave with a PoC charter and a clear execution plan. Do you have the bandwidth to run both pieces the week of Jul 26 or the following week?

Attached is the agenda we had originally planned for the intro demo (current-demo-agenda.pdf).

Thanks — happy to sync quickly on logistics.

—Emma
Emma Sullivan
Director, AI Platforms
Acme Corp
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Emma Sullivan <emma.sullivan@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: switch upcoming demo (Jul 26) to technical sprint + PoC plan

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the context. We can absolutely run a two-part technical engagement; that actually aligns better with how our Solutions team runs meaningful PoC kickoffs.

Suggested approach (high level):
- Day 1 (90m): Architecture deep-dive — integrations, latency targets, SSO/KMS considerations, data flow and retention.
- Day 2 (3h): Hands-on scoping lab — run a short integration exercise, draft a PoC charter, and define success metrics and acceptance criteria.

Availability windows I can offer:
- Week of Jul 26: Tue (Jul 28) morning or Thu (Jul 30) afternoon
- Week of Aug 2: Tue (Aug 4) full-day or Wed (Aug 5) morning

Attachments: rdw-poc-charter.docx (starter template), proposed-two-day-agenda.pdf (draft agenda for both sessions).

A few logistics/questions before we lock dates:
1) Who will be the primary technical lead from Acme (name/email)?
2) Any procurement timeline or contract decision dates we should align to?
3) Do you want our Solutions Engineer (Marissa) to own the hands-on lab?

If those windows don't work, we can do a compressed 3.5h session in one day — we prefer two shorter focused sessions, but we'll be flexible.

If this looks good I can send a calendar invite and prep notes for participants.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
Email: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123

One note: I have an all-hands during the week of Jul 26 and will be traveling on Jul 29–31. -Vivek

Please send invites and any prework. Attaching a tentative calendar invite (https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-redwood-2day) and a HubSpot deal link for reference (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/239).
